    trades = []
    buy_book = []  # List of (price, arrival_time, id, qty) - sorted by price desc, then arrival_time asc
    sell_book = []  # List of (price, arrival_time, id, qty) - sorted by price asc, then arrival_time asc
    
    order_map = {}  # Map of id to (side, price, arrival_time, index_in_book)
    arrival_time = 0
    
    for order in orders:
        arrival_time += 1
        
        if order[0] == 'cancel':
            order_id = order[1]
            if order_id in order_map:
                side, price, arr_time, book_index = order_map[order_id]
                if side == 'buy':
                    if book_index < len(buy_book) and buy_book[book_index][2] == order_id:
                        buy_book.pop(book_index)
                        # Update indices for all orders after this one in buy_book
                        for i in range(book_index, len(buy_book)):
                            oid = buy_book[i][2]
                            s, p, at, _ = order_map[oid]
                            order_map[oid] = (s, p, at, i)
                else:
                    if book_index < len(sell_book) and sell_book[book_index][2] == order_id:
                        sell_book.pop(book_index)
                        # Update indices for all orders after this one in sell_book
                        for i in range(book_index, len(sell_book)):
                            oid = sell_book[i][2]
                            s, p, at, _ = order_map[oid]
                            order_map[oid] = (s, p, at, i)
                del order_map[order_id]
        
        elif order[0] == 'market':
            order_id = order[1]
            side = order[2]
            qty = order[3]
            
            if side == 'buy':
                # Match against sell_book (lowest price first, then earliest)
                while qty > 0 and sell_book:
                    resting_price, resting_arrival, resting_id, resting_qty = sell_book[0]
                    trade_qty = min(qty, resting_qty)
                    trades.append([order_id, resting_id, resting_price, trade_qty])
                    qty -= trade_qty
                    
                    if trade_qty == resting_qty:
                        sell_book.pop(0)
                        del order_map[resting_id]
                        # Update indices for remaining orders
                        for i in range(len(sell_book)):
                            oid = sell_book[i][2]
                            s, p, at, _ = order_map[oid]
                            order_map[oid] = (s, p, at, i)
                    else:
                        sell_book[0] = (resting_price, resting_arrival, resting_id, resting_qty - trade_qty)
            else:  # sell
                # Match against buy_book (highest price first, then earliest)
                while qty > 0 and buy_book:
                    resting_price, resting_arrival, resting_id, resting_qty = buy_book[0]
                    trade_qty = min(qty, resting_qty)
                    trades.append([resting_id, order_id, resting_price, trade_qty])
                    qty -= trade_qty
                    
                    if trade_qty == resting_qty:
                        buy_book.pop(0)
                        del order_map[resting_id]
                        # Update indices for remaining orders
                        for i in range(len(buy_book)):
                            oid = buy_book[i][2]
                            s, p, at, _ = order_map[oid]
                            order_map[oid] = (s, p, at, i)
                    else:
                        buy_book[0] = (resting_price, resting_arrival, resting_id, resting_qty - trade_qty)
        
        elif order[0] == 'ioc':
            order_id = order[1]
            side = order[2]
            price = order[3]
            qty = order[4]
            
            if side == 'buy':
                # Match against sell_book (lowest price first, then earliest)

An incoming buy matches resting sells priced at or below its price (any price, for a market order): lowest price first, and among equal prices the earliest-arrived first. An incoming sell matches resting buys priced at or above its price: highest price first, then earliest-arrived. Return the trades in execution order, each as [buy_id, sell_id, price, qty]. Call submit with the code.

            else:  # sell
                # Match against buy_book (highest price first, then earliest)
                while qty > 0 and buy_book and buy_book[0][0] >= price:
                    resting_price, resting_arrival, resting_id, resting_qty = buy_book[0]
                    trade_qty = min(qty, resting_qty)
                    trades.append([resting_id, order_id, resting_price, trade_qty])
                    qty -= trade_qty
                    
                    if trade_qty == resting_qty:
                        buy_book.pop(0)
                        del order_map[resting_id]
                        # Update indices for remaining orders
                        for i in range(len(buy_book)):
                            oid = buy_book[i][2]
                            s, p, at, _ = order_map[oid]
                            order_map[oid] = (s, p, at, i)
                    else:
                        buy_book[0] = (resting_price, resting_arrival, resting_id, resting_qty - trade_qty)
                
                # Add remaining quantity to sell_book
                if qty > 0:
                    sell_book.append((price, arrival_time, order_id, qty))
                    sell_book.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
                    # Update indices
                    for i in range(len(sell_book)):
                        oid = sell_book[i][2]
                        if oid in order_map:
                            s, p, at, _ = order_map[oid]
                            order_map[oid] = (s, p, at, i)
                        else:
                            order_map[oid] = (side, price, arrival_time, i)
                    order_map[order_id] = (side, price, arrival_time, sell_book.index((price, arrival_time, order_id, qty)))
    
    return trades
